title: Acyclicity of a gate prefix
statement: Let $C$ be a finite directed acyclic Boolean circuit with $n$ input vertices, and let $k$ be a natural number. The list consisting of the first $k$ gates of $C$ is acyclic: each argument of its gate at position $i$ is a vertex with index less than $n+i$.
hypotheses_covered: C is a DAG circuit with n input vertices
